newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines appoints human rights watchdogs.
newsitem.headline: Philippines appoints human rights watchdogs.

text.p: President Fidel Ramos, acknowledging occurrences of human rights violations in the Philippines, on Tuesday swore in more than 2,000 human rights officers to monitor abuses in villages around the country.
The swearing in marked official celebration in Manila of international human rights day.

Ramos, addressing the new officers, said the creation of human rights action centres in villages "brings the cause of human rights to the grassroots, where in truth and in fact violations sometimes occur."
He said the government needed the cooperation of citizens to curb abuses.

Officials of the state's Human Rights Commission, which will supervise the officers, said their jobs would be to monitor abuses in their respective communities and report them to the commission which will investigate and recommend punishments.
